name: HCOMS Diocese Management System
shortDescription: UK diocesan-management software from Hayes Computing Solutions Ltd, connecting Church House teams and parish-facing workflows across property, compliance, finance and people records.
suitableContexts: Church of England dioceses coordinating Church House and parish operational data
Diocesan teams managing property, compliance, finance and people workflows
Parishes participating in a diocese-provided portal rather than independently buying church software

pricing.summary: HCOMS describes monthly flat-fee product platforms but does not publish DMS prices. Obtain a scoped proposal covering modules, National CMS integration, implementation, migration, hosting, support, data responsibilities and exit costs.

tiers.label: Diocese Management System
tiers.detail: Diocesan back-office and parish-facing portal for people, workflows, compliance, property and finance operations

gdprInformation: HCOMS says its DMS is hosted on UK Azure and its general terms identify the client as data controller for personal data collected via a website. The reviewed public material does not establish the complete DMS processor agreement, sub-processors, retention, access, incident and export arrangements; a diocese should obtain the current contract and data-processing schedule before sharing parish or safeguarding data.
coreFeatures: Parish, contact, role and interaction records
support: UK team and UK support stated by supplier

uk-operator.value: HCOMS terms identify Hayes Computing Solutions Ltd as the supplier. The company is registered under number 04254140 and its public material describes it as a Norwich-based UK software studio.

diocesan-scope.value: Supplier describes DMS as a diocesan platform joining Church House staff and parishes across operational areas including property, compliance, finance and people.

hosting-and-integration.value: Supplier describes DMS as hosted on UK Azure with two-way National CMS synchronisation.

data-processing.value: The reviewed public material does not establish the complete DMS data-processing schedule, sub-processors, retention, incident, access or exit arrangements.

editorial.assessment: HCOMS Diocese Management System is a specialist UK platform for Church of England diocesan operations, not a self-serve parish database. It connects Church House and parish workflows across records, property, compliance, finance and governance, with National CMS synchronisation. It will be relevant where a diocese is selecting a shared operational platform or offering a parish portal; an individual parish should establish whether access is available through its diocese and what information is shared before treating it as a local church-management alternative.
bestFor: Church of England dioceses replacing fragmented operational databases and spreadsheets
Diocesan teams needing shared Church House and parish workflow data
Parishes working within a diocese-provided portal
strengths: Specific Church of England diocesan and parish operational scope
Published National CMS integration and UK Azure hosting statement
Property, governance, finance and compliance workflows alongside people records
limitations: Not a self-serve product for an individual parish to buy independently
Public pricing, implementation and detailed support commitments require a proposal
Obtain the current DPA, sub-processor, retention, incident, permissions and exit arrangements before transferring sensitive records
Safeguarding-related workflow mentions do not establish a full safeguarding-case-management system

procurementVerdict.problem: Disconnected diocesan and parish operational information across teams and workflows
procurementVerdict.differentiator: A UK platform built around diocesan operations, parish portals and National CMS integration
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Map the diocese's priority operational workflows and the parish-data boundary, then obtain a scoped proposal and current data-processing schedule
